_comment: VERIFY before first run: filter shape against POST /api/v1/{project}/filter on the target RP 5.15 instance (Admin -> API docs / Swagger UI at https://<RP_DOMAIN>/api/). The 'any' condition with an empty value is used here as a permissive 'match everything' clause so this filter simply returns the most recent launches in start-time order.
name: Last 50 Launches
description: Most recent launches in this project, regardless of status. Used as the base filter for overview/trend widgets.
